title: Realizing Emptiness
description: Software foundation for source-faithful operationalization of the formalisms in 'There is no self-evidence: A physics of emptiness realisation' (Sandved-Smith, Fields, Doctor, Laukkonen, and Hohwy, 2026). Finite operational surrogates for paper equations 1-14, active-inference QRF profiles, Bayesian model reduction sweeps, finite quantum-information simulations, and an adversarial claim-governance layer with explicit evidence ceilings.
